name: telomi-local-qwen-vad-stress-v1
description: A paired warm-run VAD diagnostic over deterministic long-pause, white-noise, weak-onset, keyboard-like impulse and simulated far-field derivatives of source-authored human recordings. Synthetic conditions are explicit and do not satisfy the separate real-room or hardware-microphone release gates.
